PLAY · FOLLOWING A KEY

Bunny’s Path Detective

Follow the key: red circle, yellow star, purple heart. Tap the path circles in that order!

Carrot found!

Circle, star, heart — Bunny munched the carrot.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains following a key on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Bunny’s Path Detective worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
